name: @nexus/portfolio-intelligence
description: Phase 10C-2A Production Portfolio Intelligence Engine — pure, deterministic, fail-closed derivation of a complete portfolio state (summary, exposure, capital allocation, risk heat, health, warnings, statistics) from already-served TradingDecision + TradePlan outputs (the single source of truth). IO-free, clock-injected, replay-safe; recomputes NOTHING the decision/plan already carry. Consumed by the web tier.
